title.zh: 将达沃市达沃医疗中心更名为南菲律宾医疗中心、床位由六百（600）张增至一千二百（1,200）张、提升其服务设施与专业医疗护理并授权增加医务人员
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Davao Medical Center in Davao City to the Southern Philippines Medical Center, Increasing its Bed Capacity From Six Hundred (600) to One Thousand Two Hundred (1,200), Upgrading its Service Facilities and Professional Health Care, Authorizing the Increase of its Medical Personnel and Appropriating Funds therefor
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Davao Medical Center in Davao City to the Southern Philippines Medical Center, Increasing its Bed Capacity From Six Hundred (600) to One Thousand Two Hundred (1,200), Upgrading its Service Facilities and Professional Health Care, Authorizing the Increase of its Medical Personnel and Appropriating Funds therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9792_2009.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Davao Medical Center in Davao City is hereby changed to the Southern Philippines Medical Center.
The authorized bed capacity of the Southern Philippines Medical Center is hereby increased from six hundred (600) to one thousand two hundred (1,200) beds.

The existing service facilities and professional health care services of the Southern Philippines Medical Center are hereby upgraded to conform with and be commensurate to the bed capacity increase as provided for under Section 2 of this Act.2

The Department of Health, in coordination with the Department of Budget and Management and the Southern Philippines Medical Center, shall determine the additional plantilla positions to be created pursuant to this Act.

The increase in bed capacity of the Southern Philippines Medical Center from six hundred (600) to one thousand two hundred (1,200) beds shall be implemented for a period of not more than four (4) years from the approval of this Act.
The Secretary of Health shall immediately include in the Department's programs the implementation on his Act, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
